description: SSISDB ops view: live running packages, failure triage with error messages, execution status mix, catalog health (log/files/inventory), slow succeeded runs. Collector: mssql_ssis (SSISDB.catalog.*). Empty panels = SSISDB absent or no activity in lookback.

targets.expr: sum(mssql_ssisdb_failed_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) or sum(mssql_ssis_failed_total{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", window="24h"}) or vector(0)
count(mssql_ssis_running_duration_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", folder=~"${folder:regex}", project=~"${project:regex}", package=~"${package:regex}"} >= 1800) or vector(0)
count(count by (instance) (mssql_ssis_failed_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", window="24h"} > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Executions with status IN (running, pending, stopping). Duration = elapsed since start_time. Started = derived from now - duration (ms for Grafana). Sorted by Started descending (newest first).
panels.title: Currently Running (folder / project / package / caller)

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (instance, folder, project, package) (mssql_ssis_failed_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", folder=~"${folder:regex}", project=~"${project:regex}", package=~"${package:regex}", window=~"${fail_window:regex}"}))

panels.description: Only status=Failed (4). Started = start_time of THIS execution_id (mssql_ssis_failed_start_timestamp / age after collector redeploy). Sorted by Started descending.

targets.expr: (   (mssql_ssis_failed_start_timestamp{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", folder=~"${folder:regex}", project=~"${project:regex}", package=~"${package:regex}", status_desc="failed"} * 1000)   or   ((time() - mssql_ssis_failed_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", folder=~"${folder:regex}", project=~"${project:regex}", package=~"${package:regex}", status_desc="failed"}) * 1000) )

panels.title: Recent Failures (24h)

panels.description: Only last Failed (4) per package. Started = start of that same execution_id (now - age). Sorted by Started descending.
panels.title: Last Failure per Package (7d) - Failed only

panels.description: Error message_type=120 linked to failed runs. Started = most recent related execution start (collector timestamp after redeploy; else package last-fail). Sorted by Started descending.

targets.expr: (   (mssql_ssis_failed_message_last_start_timestamp{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", folder=~"${folder:regex}", project=~"${project:regex}", package=~"${package:regex}"} * 1000)   or   ((time() - mssql_ssis_failed_message_last_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", folder=~"${folder:regex}", project=~"${project:regex}", package=~"${package:regex}"}) * 1000) )

panels.title: Error Messages on Failed Runs (24h)

panels.description: One row per server: folder / project / package / environment counts.
panels.title: Catalog Inventory

panels.description: Started = start_time of THIS Op ID. Click Server/Job for related reports (Job Running / Failed / History). Sorted by Started descending.
panels.title: Running Catalog Operations

title: Collector ssis
